description: Takes { capability, budget, deadline }. Sanitizes the input, ranks active suppliers against the capability using the gateway's ranking engine (scripts/rank-suppliers.js), and returns the ranked supplier list with scores, agent IDs, and payTo addresses. If no supplier clears the capability floor, returns a no_match response. This tool NEVER initiates payment — the buyer settles via the HTTP /route endpoint with the x402 challenge.

budget.description: Maximum budget in USDC the buyer will pay

deadline.description: Deadline in seconds from now for delivery

name: route_request
title: Route a demand to ranked suppliers
